origin.text: Our coffee comes from the Agron Cereale Minerio farm in Brazil. Every bean is carefully selected and roasted in small batches to preserve its unique flavor and aroma.

original.hero: Strong, balanced flavor for everyday office enjoyment.
original.description: Coffece Original is our flagship 100% Arabica blend from Brazil. With an intensity of 4/5, it offers a rich, full-bodied taste with subtle chocolate tones and a nutty finish. Perfect for those who appreciate classic coffee without compromise.
original.notes: Chocolate tones, nutty finish, full body

zlaty.hero: Premium select Arabica for discerning coffee lovers.
zlaty.description: Coffece Gold Standard is our premium 100% select Arabica blend. Carefully chosen beans from Brazilian farms deliver a delicate, complex flavor with fruity and floral notes. For those seeking the very best.
zlaty.notes: Fruity and floral notes, gentle acidity, silky body

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Can't find your answer? Contact us.

items.q: What is the minimum order quantity?
items.a: The minimum order is 1 kg of coffee (4 packs of 250g). For larger offices, we recommend regular deliveries.
Simply fill out our online form or contact us by phone. We'll prepare a custom offer for you.
We accept bank transfer and invoice payments. Regular customers can opt for monthly billing.
We deliver throughout Slovakia. For Bratislava and surrounding areas, we provide our own delivery service.

items.q: How often can I receive coffee?
items.a: We offer weekly, bi-weekly, or monthly deliveries. You can change the frequency at any time.

items.q: What's the difference between Original and Gold Standard?
items.a: Original is our classic 100% Arabica blend with a full-bodied taste. Gold Standard is a premium select Arabica with a more delicate, complex flavor profile.

items.q: How long does the coffee stay fresh?
items.a: We recommend consuming within 4 weeks of roasting for the best flavor. The roast date is printed on every package.

items.q: How should I store the coffee?
items.a: Keep in a dry, dark place in a sealed container. We don't recommend storing in the refrigerator.

items.q: Do you offer a trial order?
items.a: Yes! Your first order is commitment-free. Try our coffee and decide for yourself.

items.q: Can I cancel my order anytime?
items.a: Of course. We have no long-term contracts. You can cancel or pause your order at any time.
